snippet.title: Teaser Trailer  2 - Lost Sanity: Cthulhu
snippet.description:
"Lost Sanity: Cthulhu" is a horror and exploration game where each chapter is a new story.
A group of teenagers come together to tell horror stories, and each story is represented as a chapter of "Lost Sanity".
Beginning with the tale of "Cthulhu", a cosmic entity that lies dormant in its submerged city in the sea, occultists gather with the goal of awakening the entity.

You are in the role of Megan Claire, a former reporter, who wakes up in a kind of prison and now your goal is to understand what is happening there and escape as quickly as possible!
